library.rt_040:r_0559e33d1b4c397c.text:
A Newtype-only mobile suit developed by Anaheim Electronics at Londo Bell's request. Pilot $$アムロ・レイ$$ handled its design personally.
Developed by analyzing the performance of previous Gundams and incorporating the latest technology, it was completed as an ultra-high-performance machine that belies its hurried construction.
The psycoframe built in around the cockpit gives it extraordinary mobility and responsiveness. It is also the first Gundam-type mobile suit to be equipped with a psycommu weapon, the Fin Funnel. Larger than ordinary funnels, they output correspondingly more power. Besides their use as weapons, several can be linked together to generate an I-Field, forming an anti-beam barrier, making them useful in both offense and defense.

library.rt_040:r_99c367dc700ccc9b.text:
A Newtype-only mobile suit developed by Anaheim Electronics at Londo Bell's request. Pilot $$アムロ・レイ$$ handled its design personally.
Developed by analyzing the performance of previous Gundams and incorporating the latest technology, it was completed as an ultra-high-performance machine that belies its hurried construction.
The psycoframe built in around the cockpit gives it extraordinary mobility and responsiveness. It is also the first Gundam-type mobile suit to be equipped with a psycommu weapon, the Fin Funnel. Larger than ordinary funnels, they output correspondingly more power. Besides their use as weapons, several can be linked together to generate an I-Field, forming an anti-beam barrier, making them useful in both offense and defense.
In order to stop Neo Zeon's attempt to drop $$アクシズ$$, it challenged $$シャア$$'s $$サザビー$$, likewise equipped with a psycoframe, to a decisive battle, and won.
Afterward, the sight of it struggling to push $$アクシズ$$ back united the hearts of many people, and a shining force field formed by the psycoframe altered $$アクシズ$$'s trajectory.
That light became known as the '$$アクシズ$$ Shock,' and it affected many people.

library.rt_040:r_239db62b618f8601.text:
A prototype mobile suit developed by Anaheim Electronics.
It is a simplified mass-production prototype of the $$Ｚガンダム$$, and becomes a mobile armor when equipped with the Back Weapon System. This mechanism let it maintain high performance while improving ease of production, aiming for mass production. Even so, its production cost remained high compared to other mass-produced units, and in the end only a single unit saw actual deployment, with the Londo Bell task force.
$$リ・ガズィ$$ is short for 'Refined Gundam Zeta.'
Its main armaments, besides the Back Weapon System, are a beam saber, beam rifle, twin grenade launcher, vulcan guns, and so on.

library.rt_040:r_c5a02ba6dd54bdec.text:
The mobile armor form taken when the $$リ・ガズィ$$ equips the Back Weapon System.
Its mobility, long-range cruising ability, firepower, and more are all dramatically improved. However, the Back Weapon System is used in a nearly disposable manner, and once detached to return to mobile suit form, it cannot be re-equipped on the battlefield.
Its main armaments are the mega beam cannon mounted on the nose, missile launchers, and so on.

library.rt_040:r_40d1d5e630e752cb.text:
A mass-production mobile suit that serves as the Earth Federation Forces' mainstay unit.
Developed by combining the design data of the GM and Nemo lines, both of which had undergone extensive development and improvement, it boasts high performance and reliability. It was preferentially deployed to the Londo Bell task force and saw long service across many theaters afterward.
Notably, it was the first Federation mainstay unit to be developed and mass-produced not within the military itself but by Anaheim Electronics.
Its main armaments are a beam rifle, beam saber, vulcan guns, hand grenades, and so on.

library.rt_040:r_8a6ce680c9d25f5f.text:
The flagship of the Earth Federation Forces' Londo Bell task force.
Its captain is Colonel $$ブライト・ノア$$, and like the Gundam-carrying ships before it, white forms the base of its color scheme.
Besides its usual launch catapult, it is notable for a dedicated landing deck at the stern of the hull. It also has a highly armored combat bridge, separate from the bridge used under ordinary circumstances.
Its basic performance is high, and sister ships remained in service more than fifty years after its development.
Besides its main armament of four twin mega particle cannons, it carries countless missile launchers and machine guns.

library.rt_040:r_7a6b76feaa6f3e12.text:
A mass-production mobile suit of the Neo Zeon forces.
A machine that could be called the culmination of Zeon-line mobile suits to date, it is characterized by the high versatility of its abundant equipment options and the high production efficiency of its simple structure, and it serves as Neo Zeon's mainstay unit.
Its main armaments are a beam machine gun, beam sword axe, Sturm Faust, grenade launcher, electromagnetic wire, and so on.

library.rt_040:r_e68a074da1a34742.text:
A mass-production mobile suit of the Neo Zeon forces.
As a squad leader's machine, it is equipped with the headdress traditional to Zeon.
Though given blue coloring as $$レズン$$'s personal machine, its performance differs little from that of standard-issue units, and its armaments are the same as well.

library.rt_040:r_29ba12e8eb9a7c28.text:
A Newtype-only mobile suit of the Neo Zeon forces.
Developed at Anaheim Electronics' Granada plant. Two units were built as prototypes, and the blue unit among them became $$ギュネイ$$'s personal machine.
It adopts a psycoframe, giving it excellent control responsiveness and readiness.
Besides a beam assault rifle, beam saber, and the quad mega particle cannon built into its shield, it carries six funnels.

library.rt_040:r_7413ef6053a8f852.text:
A Newtype-only mobile suit of the Neo Zeon forces.
Developed at Anaheim Electronics' Granada plant. Two units were built as prototypes, and the blue unit among them became $$ギュネイ$$'s personal machine.
It adopts a psycoframe, giving it excellent control responsiveness and readiness.
Besides a beam assault rifle, beam saber, and the quad mega particle cannon built into its shield, it carries six funnels.
In the battle for $$アクシズ$$, it distinguished itself by shooting down every nuclear missile fired by the Londo Bell task force, but was itself shot down by the $$νガンダム$$.

library.rt_040:r_caee38a34962a3e2.text:
A Newtype-only mobile suit of the Neo Zeon forces.
Developed at Anaheim Electronics' Granada plant. Two units were built as prototypes, and the red unit among them became $$クェス$$'s personal machine.
It adopts a psycoframe, giving it excellent control responsiveness and readiness.
Much of its armament, including its six funnels, is shared with $$ギュネイ$$'s machine, but $$クェス$$'s machine is equipped with a mega gatling gun.

library.rt_040:r_1d00c83d09a8b869.text:
A Newtype-only mobile suit of the Neo Zeon forces.
Developed at Anaheim Electronics' Granada plant. Two units were built as prototypes, and the red unit among them became $$クェス$$'s personal machine.
It adopts a psycoframe, giving it excellent control responsiveness and readiness.
Much of its armament, including its six funnels, is shared with $$ギュネイ$$'s machine, but $$クェス$$'s machine is equipped with a mega gatling gun.

library.rt_040:r_206b211d4587aedc.text:
A giant Newtype-only mobile armor of the Neo Zeon forces.
It was developed with reference to psycommu-compatible machines such as the Elmeth and the $$キュベレイ$$.
Its main armaments include a mega particle cannon, twin vulcan guns, a wired psycommu-type mega arm cannon, funnels, and so on.
It was designed with anti-ship combat in mind, and possesses firepower to rival a warship. Its control relies on a psycommu, and its wired mega arm cannon and large funnels enable all-range attacks as well.
The huge Sturm Boosters on its legs can also be jettisoned after use.
With $$クェス$$ as its pilot, it was deployed as Neo Zeon's trump card in the operation to cool the Earth.

library.rt_040:r_c492805c4093670f.text:
A Newtype-only mobile suit of the Neo Zeon forces.
The personal machine of Supreme Commander $$シャア・アズナブル$$, colored deep crimson.
By adopting a psycoframe, it achieved a level of responsiveness far beyond that of previous machine types. Despite its heavy armor, its many thrusters also give it high mobility, making it a powerful machine worthy of $$シャア$$.
Its main armaments -- a beam shot rifle, an abdominal mega particle cannon, a beam saber, funnels, and more -- give it overwhelming firepower that outclasses all others.

library.rt_040:r_2920eaf9a6e912ad.text:
A Newtype-only mobile suit of the Neo Zeon forces.
The personal machine of Supreme Commander $$シャア・アズナブル$$, colored deep crimson.
By adopting a psycoframe, it achieved a level of responsiveness far beyond that of previous machine types. Despite its heavy armor, its many thrusters also give it high mobility, making it a powerful machine worthy of $$シャア$$.
Its main armaments -- a beam shot rifle, an abdominal mega particle cannon, a beam saber, funnels, and more -- give it overwhelming firepower that outclasses all others.

library.rt_040:r_2bcc7cb5a4d785ca.text:
The flagship of the Neo Zeon forces.
An evolution of the Gwazine-class battleship, formerly the flagship of the old Principality of Zeon forces, inheriting its propulsion system, coolant tanks, and other features.
This ship's firepower and mobile suit capacity are the greatest of any vessel in either the Neo Zeon or Earth Federation forces, and it fought as the core of the fleet during the Second Neo Zeon War.

library.rt_040:r_b5a17f59e366cd5d.text:
A mainstay light cruiser of the Neo Zeon forces.
An evolution of the Musai-class, Zeon's iconic warship.
It is equipped with folding heat-radiating fins and has high cruising performance.

library.rt_040:r_c1fc54d52391180f.text:
A mainstay light cruiser of the Neo Zeon forces.
An evolution of the Musai-class, Zeon's iconic warship.
It is equipped with folding heat-radiating fins and has high cruising performance.
In the surprise attack on Ruuna Two, numerous decoys of this ship were used to disguise the true size of the fleet.

library.rt_040:r_46ab88d386b281f8.text:
The Gundam piloted by $$ヒイロ・ユイ$$.
Its distinguishing feature is the bird-wing-like plumage mounted on its back. These wing-shaped parts, called Wing Binders, produce extraordinary mobility and maneuverability. They also serve many other functions, such as a heat shield for atmospheric reentry and a shock absorber when firing the Buster Rifle.
This unit was developed with single-handed base capture as its main focus, and possesses overwhelming firepower in addition to its mobility. Its main armament, the Twin Buster Rifle, has the drawback of being able to fire only three shots, but carries enough power to destroy a colony in a single blast. Its high mobility also lets it perform well in close combat with its beam saber.
Its cockpit houses the 'Zero System,' which communicates to the pilot's brain, through the console, the actions the system determines necessary for victory. Though an extremely useful system in combat, it places a heavy mental burden on the pilot and often causes them to run out of control. However, $$ヒイロ$$ overcame the system during the previous war and came to use it completely.
After the war it was meant to be disposed of by dropping it into the sun, but it returned to $$ヒイロ$$'s hands once more to suppress the $$マリーメイア$$ Army's uprising.

library.rt_040:r_22e9844ff836db87.text:

Its distinguishing feature is the bird-wing-like plumage mounted on its back. These wing-shaped parts, called Wing Binders, produce extraordinary mobility and maneuverability. They also serve many other functions, such as a heat shield for atmospheric reentry and a shock absorber when firing the Buster Rifle.

Its cockpit houses the 'Zero System,' which communicates to the pilot's brain, through the console, the actions the system determines necessary for victory. After the war it was meant to be disposed of by dropping it into the sun, but it returned to $$ヒイロ$$'s hands once more to suppress the $$マリーメイア$$ Army's uprising, and fought $$アルトロンガンダム$$ just short of the atmosphere.
Next, in order to destroy the nuclear shelter beneath the presidential residence where $$マリーメイア$$ had barricaded herself, it fired its Twin Buster Rifle in rapid succession despite being half-wrecked. It succeeded in destroying the shelter, but the recoil left the unit itself badly damaged as well, bringing its role to an end.

library.rt_040:r_d2f3e41f7f5f829e.text:
The Gundam piloted by $$デュオ$$.
With the Active Cloak on its back -- doubling as a shield and flight control unit -- spread wide, and its Beam Scissors held at the ready, its silhouette evokes the image of a 'Grim Reaper.'
Its Hyper Jammer, which temporarily disables enemy sensors, gives it high stealth capability, and it excels at attacking enemies from their blind spots.
Even in head-on combat, it boasts high close-combat ability with its Beam Scissors.

library.rt_040:r_983346453839a717.text:
The Gundam piloted by $$デュオ$$.
With the Active Cloak on its back -- doubling as a shield and flight control unit -- spread wide, and its Beam Scissors held at the ready, its silhouette evokes the image of a 'Grim Reaper.'
Its Hyper Jammer, which temporarily disables enemy sensors, gives it high stealth capability, and it excels at attacking enemies from their blind spots.
Even in head-on combat, it boasts high close-combat ability with its Beam Scissors.
After the $$マリーメイア$$ Army's uprising was suppressed, believing weapons had no place in an age of peace, $$デュオ$$ scrapped it with his own hands.

library.rt_040:r_42bcd8c8b91a5847.text:
The Gundam piloted by $$トロワ$$.
Developed under the concept of single-handed base capture and combat against numerous targets, it carries a huge volume of firearms over its entire body.
The Barton Foundation was involved in its development, and its main armament, the Double Gatling Gun, is also used by the $$サーペント$$.
With its elegant mobility, this unit wields two of these gatling guns at once, overwhelming the $$サーペント$$ forces.

library.rt_040:r_769b2fdb3427d024.text:
The Gundam piloted by $$トロワ$$.
Developed under the concept of single-handed base capture and combat against numerous targets, it carries a huge volume of firearms over its entire body.
The Barton Foundation was involved in its development, and its main armament, the Double Gatling Gun, is also used by the $$サーペント$$.
With its elegant mobility, this unit wields two of these gatling guns at once, overwhelming the $$サーペント$$ forces.
After the $$マリーメイア$$ Army's uprising was suppressed, believing weapons had no place in an age of peace, $$トロワ$$ scrapped it with his own hands.

library.rt_040:r_001be1f7e51f4d31.text:
The Gundam piloted by $$カトル$$.
A machine excelling in power and defense, with large Heat Shotels as its main armament.
Multiple sensors are mounted in its head, giving it excellent information-gathering ability. Using this information, it analyzes the battlefield situation and sends precise instructions to allied units.
Its armor strength is the highest among the five Gundams, and it can also equip a cloak fitted with reinforced armor and anti-beam coating.

library.rt_040:r_94d4fcfe79f4d814.text:
The Gundam piloted by $$カトル$$.
A machine excelling in power and defense, with large Heat Shotels as its main armament.
Multiple sensors are mounted in its head, giving it excellent information-gathering ability. Using this information, it analyzes the battlefield situation and sends precise instructions to allied units.
Its armor strength is the highest among the five Gundams, and it can also equip a cloak fitted with reinforced armor and anti-beam coating.
After the $$マリーメイア$$ Army was suppressed, believing weapons had no place in an age of peace, $$カトル$$ scrapped it with his own hands.

library.rt_040:r_6e8d4508728dcd9c.text:
The Gundam piloted by $$五飛$$.
A machine specialized for close combat, with excellent mobility.
Its only carried weapon is the Beam Trident, making it extremely specialized for melee combat, but the Dragon Fangs equipped on both arms also allow it to fight at medium range. Living up to the name 'Twin-Headed Dragon,' these weapons can freely extend and retract, and thanks to a multi-jointed structure of interlocking square segments, they can unleash flexible attacks.

library.rt_040:r_e0e7155b2a49afcd.text:
The Gundam piloted by $$五飛$$.
A machine specialized for close combat, with excellent mobility.
Its only carried weapon is the Beam Trident, making it extremely specialized for melee combat, but the Dragon Fangs equipped on both arms also allow it to fight at medium range. Living up to the name 'Twin-Headed Dragon,' these weapons can freely extend and retract, and thanks to a multi-jointed structure of interlocking square segments, they can unleash flexible attacks.
It belonged to the $$マリーメイア$$ Army and stood in the way of $$ヒイロ$$ and the others, but after the uprising was suppressed, $$五飛$$ scrapped it with his own hands.

library.rt_040:r_414b8e4ba26deeca.text:
A variable mobile suit developed as the mainstay unit succeeding the $$リーオー$$.
Its name is drawn from '$$トーラス$$,' the bull of the twelve zodiac constellations.
Though developed as a mobile suit for space use, its variable transformation function lets it maintain high mobility even in operations within the atmosphere.
It can also carry a beam cannon capable of destroying even Gundanium alloy, and its performance surpasses the $$リーオー$$ and Aries in every respect.
The white-colored units were deployed to defend the Sank Kingdom, used mainly by $$ノイン$$, and fought alongside the Gundams during the $$マリーメイア$$ Army's uprising as well.

library.rt_040:r_811b7ba359460452.text:
The mobile armor form of the $$トーラス$$.
With the movable thrusters on its back serving as main wings, and using the thrusters on the soles of its feet, it can also fly under gravity.
Capable of high mobility, it excelled at hit-and-run tactics.

library.rt_040:r_4ccc4cfcd905a83a.text:
A derivative of the Tallgeese, developed on $$トレーズ$$ Khushrenada's orders.
It is a machine that retains the Tallgeese's extreme performance of 'high mobility, heavy armor,' while further reinforcing its offensive power.
True to that concept, its newly equipped Mega Cannon surpasses the Dover Gun in power, and at maximum output can destroy even a resource satellite in a single shot.
The Mega Cannon can also adjust its power by adjusting the length of its barrel, allowing for flexible tactics suited to the battlefield situation.
After the war it was kept under the management of the Preventers, but it was operated as $$ゼクス・マーキス$$'s mount during the $$マリーメイア$$ Army's uprising.

library.rt_040:r_b7360722d80a998b.text:
A mass-production heavy mobile suit that forms the mainstay of the $$マリーメイア$$ Army.
Developed by the Barton Foundation, which was also involved in developing the Gundam Heavyarms.
A machine that excels at ranged combat, it can carry powerful ranged weapons such as the Double Gatling Gun and Beam Cannon, the same type used by the $$ガンダムヘビーアームズ改$$.
Its armor is also made from a new material said to match the hardness of Gundanium alloy, Neo-Titanium alloy, giving it high defensive power.
During the $$マリーメイア$$ Army's uprising, close to 400 units descended on Brussels and fought against the Gundams.

library.rt_040:r_9b0ff0bfea864484.text:
A mobile suit developed by the Earth $$スフィア$$ Unified Nation.
Its name is drawn from '$$リーオー$$,' the lion of the twelve zodiac constellations.
Development prioritized mass-producibility and versatility, and it was mass-produced in greater numbers than any other unit by both the Earth $$スフィア$$ Unified Nation and OZ.
It carries no fixed armament, making it a simple, quirk-free machine.
Though designed as a mobile suit for ground use, it can also be operated in space by swapping its backpack.
Having been used on the front lines for over twenty years since its development, many variants exist. This coloring is the one $$ヒイロ$$ used when infiltrating MO-III.

library.rt_040:r_6a69f0bf727e7ecd.text:
A mobile suit developed by the Earth $$スフィア$$ Unified Nation.
Its name is drawn from '$$リーオー$$,' the lion of the twelve zodiac constellations.
Development prioritized mass-producibility and versatility, and it was mass-produced in greater numbers than any other unit by both the Earth $$スフィア$$ Unified Nation and OZ.
It carries no fixed armament, making it a simple, quirk-free machine.
Though designed as a mobile suit for ground use, it can also be operated in space by swapping its backpack.
Having been used on the front lines for over twenty years since its development, many variants exist.

library.rt_040:r_74249bc0355588eb.text:
$$ザフト$$'s newest mobile suit, developed to bring an end to the war with the $$地球連合$$ forces.
As $$シン$$ grew at a rapid pace, $$デュランダル$$, believing the Impulse Gundam could no longer make full use of his talent, had detailed adjustments made to this unit, making it effectively $$シン$$'s personal machine.
It is equipped with the 'Hyper Deuterion Engine,' a power plant that combines nuclear power with a Deuterion beam power transmission system, and it generates Wings of Light from its wing parts to display tremendous mobility.
It combines the strengths of all three of the Impulse Gundam's forms, succeeding in achieving both a versatile arsenal effective at any range and outstanding mobility. It further adds unique functions such as palm-mounted beam cannons and an afterimage effect derived from Mirage Colloid technology, realizing the concept of a single unit capable of responding to any battlefield situation.

library.rt_040:r_60ab61347b137388.text:
$$ザフト$$'s newest mobile suit, developed to bring an end to the war with the $$地球連合$$ forces.
As $$シン$$ grew at a rapid pace, $$デュランダル$$, believing the Impulse Gundam could no longer make full use of his talent, had detailed adjustments made to this unit, making it effectively $$シン$$'s personal machine.
It is equipped with the 'Hyper Deuterion Engine,' a power plant that combines nuclear power with a Deuterion beam power transmission system, and it generates Wings of Light from its wing parts to display tremendous mobility.
It combines the strengths of all three of the Impulse Gundam's forms, succeeding in achieving both a versatile arsenal effective at any range and outstanding mobility. It further adds unique functions such as palm-mounted beam cannons and an afterimage effect derived from Mirage Colloid technology, realizing the concept of a single unit capable of responding to any battlefield situation.
During the Battle of Messiah, it was badly damaged in combat with the Infinite Justice and fell to the lunar surface as is, withdrawing from the fighting.

library.rt_040:r_66f57d75a8cbc1c9.text:
A state-of-the-art mobile suit developed alongside the Infinite Justice at '$$ファクトリー$$,' the base of the Clyne Faction, the anti-$$デュランダル$$ faction.
It is equipped with a new-model laser fusion engine, boasting several times the output of the Freedom.
Its newly equipped 'Super Dragoon (Mobile Weapon System)' separates the wing sections that boost its mobility and uses them as wirelessly guided beam weapons. On its first sortie, it used this new weapon to disable a total of 25 ZAKU Warriors and GOUF Ignited units in just two minutes.
Its armor has also been changed to VPS armor, and it even has built-in beam shields, making it a machine with no openings to exploit in either offense or defense.
However, bringing out its full power requires a high level of piloting skill, and it is said to be difficult for anyone other than $$キラ$$ to operate.

library.rt_040:r_0999a88a9cd4ab8a.text:
The form taken when the 0 Raiser, a support unit, combines with the 00 Gundam, Celestial Being's fourth-generation Gundam piloted by $$刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ$$.
The 00 Gundam was developed with the Twin Drive system as a premise, but because synchronizing its two GN Drives proved difficult, it was operated docked with the 0 Raiser, which was given the role of a control unit.
During Trans-Am, it demonstrated performance beyond its original design specs, among other things generating a shared consciousness space through the GN particles it released.
For this reason, the 'Gundam' was dropped from its name, and it was christened '$$ダブルオーライザー$$,' as 'something that surpasses the Gundam.'
After its original GN Drive was destroyed in the battle against the Innovades, it has been operated since the war's end with a particle storage tank installed in place of the GN Drive. Even in this state its basic performance is not inferior, and Trans-Am remains possible, though its activation time has become extremely short.

library.rt_040:r_1bf3aa9ffc62c073.text:
Celestial Being's fifth-generation Gundam, developed as the successor to the $$ダブルオーライザー$$.
Piloted by $$刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ$$.
A machine developed under the concept of making maximum use of the abilities of $$刹那$$, who awakened as an Innovator.
Its basic frame is built around the 00 Gundam, which had already reached a state of near-perfection, but its internal components, such as its electronic systems, have been overhauled.
Like the 00 Gundam, it adopts the Twin Drive system, but because the GN Drives mounted in this unit were newly built with the Twin Drive system as a premise from the start, it achieves full synchronization without needing the 0 Raiser.
Its distinctive armament is the GN Sword Bits. Its six Sword Bits can not only attack independently, but also generate a GN Field, letting them serve as shields as well. Linking them with the GN Sword V also turns them into powerful equipment such as the GN Buster Rifle and GN Buster Sword.
On paper, this unit was completed with combat power surpassing that of the $$ダブルオーライザー$$, but its ultimate purpose lies elsewhere, apart from combat.

library.rt_040:r_85c7a9f03be38c7b.text:
Celestial Being's fifth-generation Gundam, inheriting the lineage of the Cherudim Gundam.
Piloted by $$ロックオン・ストラトス$$.
The Dynames and Cherudim before it were developed as sniper-specialized machines to make use of their pilots' aptitudes, but this unit has been redesigned to enable omnidirectional fire, taking into account combat against numerous opponents.
Its main armament is multiple GN Rifle Bits II, usable both as rifles and as pistols. These can also be used as remotely guided weapons and deployed simultaneously. Furthermore, the holsters that store these rifles can themselves be deployed as shield bits.
It also carries GN Micro Missiles throughout its body, improving its firepower.
Its increasingly complex fire control is supported by two $$ハロ$$ units, allowing all of these weapons to be used at the same time.
With this equipment, this unit is completed as a bombardment-type mobile suit capable of responding at any range.

library.rt_040:r_11ee779a12307e2f.text:
Celestial Being's fifth-generation Gundam, an evolution of the Arios Gundam.
Piloted by $$アレルヤ・ハプティズム$$ and $$マリー・パーファシー$$.
The Gundam types piloted by $$アレルヤ$$ had until now been developed with mobility as the priority, but this unit was developed under the concept of improving combat power through heavier armament, taking into account combat against numerous opponents.
As carried weapons, it is equipped with two GN Sword Rifles. With a GN Cannon and a large missile container as standard equipment on its back, its firepower has been greatly improved over the Arios. The GN Sword Rifle is a dual-purpose weapon for both ranged and melee combat, and by deploying its sword section it can also be used as the GN Claw, the Arios's signature equipment.
It was developed from the start as a two-seater, allowing its increasingly complex fire control and machine control to be handled separately by its two pilots.

library.rt_040:r_0ebb8ce68048aa81.text:
A Gundam that $$ティエリア$$, sleeping within $$ヴェーダ$$, was secretly developing aboard the Celestial Being mothership.
A machine developed based on the 'Ga' series used by the Innovades, it shows shared elements with them in many places.
Though its development path differs, it inherits the design philosophy of the Virtue and Seravee, with the concept of a high-firepower mobile suit for base capture.
Its massive weapon unit on the head mounts the GN Big Cannon, a high-firepower weapon directly linked to a GN Drive. The cannon can also be used as a giant GN Claw capable of remote operation.

library.rt_040:r_88303de7661f1423.text:
A $$ユニオンフラッグ$$ used by Celestial Being.
Celestial Being, refraining from operating the 'Gundam,' whose meaning as a deterrent had grown too strong, uses this instead.
Modifications to its various parts allow for customization suited to each pilot's abilities, and the unit used by $$刹那$$ was equipped with a GN Sword II Kai with a built-in GN Condenser.

library.rt_040:r_f08dda1644853063.text:
A multipurpose ship that serves as the starting point for Celestial Being's operations.
Foreseeing the shift of the times toward space development after the war against the Innovades, it underwent modifications aimed at long-range voyages.
Its basic performance remains that of the Ptolemaios 2, but it has been fitted with an additional long-range, detachable large booster that integrates a GN Condenser into its main thrusters. This has greatly strengthened its cruising capability.

library.rt_040:r_039b9dee6745abe3.text:
The $$プトレマイオス２改$$ in its Trans-Am state.
Its mobility and maneuverability are dramatically improved, and the GN particles it releases can also be used as a barrier.
In the case of the unmodified Ptolemaios 2, Trans-Am relied on GN particles from its storage tank, making sustained activation impossible. After the refit, however, system optimization has greatly extended its activation time.

library.rt_040:r_af3a406d3739a581.text:
A technology test unit for the Earth Federation Forces, developed mainly by engineers from the former Union and AEU.
It was developed with the concept of making the Masurao, Mister Bushido's personal machine, more general-purpose, and organizing a rapid deployment force.
To meet this concept, the unit needed extended range and improved mobility, so it was fitted with a transformable cruising form that had been omitted from the Masurao.
Its carried weapons, previously centered on melee combat, have been changed to ranged weapons such as the GN Beam Rifle. This weapon can be used not only as a high-output beam rifle, but its tip can also be removed to increase its rate of fire, allowing for a wide range of uses suited to the battlefield situation.
The commander type piloted by $$グラハム$$ is also equipped with two pseudo solar reactors and a large GN Beam Saber, allowing it to fight in melee combat just as the Masurao does.
It has already entered the evaluation testing phase, and early production units have been deployed to 'Sol Braves,' the squadron led by $$グラハム$$.

library.rt_040:r_20d694d8c6c4937b.text:
A mobile suit deployed as the Earth Federation Forces' mainstay unit.
It carries a pseudo solar reactor, allowing it to maintain stable power output.
Its standard-equipment GN Lance can also be used in both ranged and melee combat, letting it respond to any situation.
Various color variants exist depending on the faction using it, and this version, used by the terrorists who attacked $$マリナ・イスマイール$$, was painted yellow and white.

library.rt_040:r_05391d823a640dfd.text:
A mainstay mobile suit of the Earth Federation Forces.
There are commander and mass-production types; this coloring is the commander type.
The former Federation forces' mainstay unit had been shifting to the Ahead, but after $$アロウズ$$' atrocities came to light, production of the Ahead, so strongly associated with that organization's image, was halted. In its place, this unit, a development of the GN-X series, was adopted as the mainstay unit.
With the Celestial Being mothership placed under Federation control, Gundam technology has been actively diverted for its use, realizing the adoption of Trans-Am and backup support from $$ヴェーダ$$ as well.
A wide range of optional equipment exists, such as the GN Bazooka and GN Buster Sword, allowing for customization according to the mission and pilot.

library.rt_040:r_d999219cd54d2842.text:
A prototype mobile suit that was secretly under development at Anaheim Electronics.
A machine colored pure white all over, with a single horn on its head reminiscent of a unicorn.
Its movable frame is formed entirely of psycoframe, giving it extraordinarily high control responsiveness.
Its armament is also powerful; its main weapon, the Beam Magnum, delivers the power of four ordinary beam rifle shots in a single blast. However, it has the drawback of needing to eject an energy pack after every shot, meaning it can only fire five shots even carrying a full load of packs. Besides this, it can mount abundant optional equipment, such as the Hyper Bazooka, suited to the battlefield situation.
This unit was developed as the core of the Federation's top-secret 'Unicorn Project,' and much information about it remains classified. So thorough is this secrecy that even those involved in its development cannot grasp anything outside their own assigned area.
Its cockpit is fitted with a biometric authentication system, and no one but $$バナージ・リンクス$$, the first person registered to it, can operate it.
